svg.text: SAP Merchandise Requests: morning file, live changes from SAP (pending until the day's file), and how open MRAs take capacity · v1.1.7 rules, schema v7 · 6 Nov 2026
A · Morning MRA file (Planner, Data Setup)
B · Live changes from SAP (all day)
C · How the tool uses the MRAs
Read item lines: DOC.NO, Generic Article (last 10
digits), Color, TOTAL PO QTY added up per MRA,
DEL. DATE, LEVEL · header sheet: PO, status, created by
Normalise level / date / qty – rows that cannot be
read are skipped and counted in the summary
Keep a decision SAP sent earlier when the
file has none for that MRA
1. SAP_MRA_FILE emptied and filled from the file
2. Changes already applied today re-tagged to the new version
3. Pending SAP changes moved into SAP_MRA_FEED
Summary under the slot: MRAs per level, counted now,
rows skipped, “N SAP changes received before this
file were applied on top of it”
Read each message: mra_no, level (1–9, X) – optional
Replay file + messages of the current version:
older (occurred_at before the last change) · parked ·
stored (PO message) · new MRA needs article, colour,
Answer to SAP: one result per message, same order
at the upload: pending changes are moved onto the new file (step 3)
Every New PO request, SAP /decisions, single concept
Recommendation, MRA Queues: current MRA position
Morning file + messages of the current data version
replayed → level, qty, PO, history of every MRA
by a live change today with the
Counted: qty added to the released
POs of its colour and delivery month
(a live PO change governs it, switch 2)
Max Permissible = what is still free after the plan,
the stock, released POs (F2), open MRAs and today's
tool approvals – New PO request card shows “Open
MRAs from SAP counted in this colour”
file + feed of the current data version → replay
New day: IsDailyDataUpload = No (until today's file)
File replaces the list; pending moved on top; flag = Yes
SAP changes applied at once (same data version)
Same-day changes kept on the new version
Where the data is kept (SQL Server, schema v7, procedure PRO_SAP_MRA)
the morning file: one row per MRA (article, colour, qty, delivery date, level, POs)
one row per upload: file, by, counts, how many pending changes were moved
every live change applied, in order, with its Data_Version (also bad ones, “parked”)
temporary table: changes received before today's file – emptied by the upload
one row: Data_Day, IsDailyDataUpload, Data_Version (= Upload ID of the file in use)
